memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh, gate functions are dispatched DYNAMICALLY as "gate${_gate_id}_run" driven by gate_registry_ids() iterating gate-registry.data -- there is no static call-site list of gateN_run invocations to edit. Adding a new gate therefore requires exactly two edits: one 9-field TAB-separated row in gate-registry.data and one gateN_run function definition. Before planning a 'wire up the new gate's call site' step, grep for 'gate25_run' and observe it appears only as its own definition, never as a call.
